scenes.text: In the number 364, what is the value of the digit in the hundreds place? Let us think carefully. 364 has 3 hundreds, 6 tens and 4 ones. The answer is 300. Great work!
In the number 478, what is the value of the digit in the tens place? Let us think carefully. 478 has 4 hundreds, 7 tens and 8 ones. The answer is 70. Great work!
In the number 205, what is the value of the digit in the ones place? Let us think carefully. 205 has 2 hundreds, 0 tens and 5 ones. The answer is 5. Great work!
In the number 629, what is the value of the digit in the hundreds place? Let us think carefully. 629 has 6 hundreds, 2 tens and 9 ones. The answer is 600. Great work!
